title: Separate execution timeout requeue state from publish failure recovery
scope: execution timeout recovery now moves stale REVIEWING tasks through REQUEUE_PENDING before direct republish
publish compensation only scans true PUBLISH_FAILED tasks while manual requeue remains compatible with legacy EXECUTION_TIMEOUT tasks
failed recovery republish is converted to PUBLISH_FAILED with sanitized error detail and retry timing
queue health, dashboard labels and metrics expose REQUEUE_PENDING and distinguish execute-phase publish failures
remaining: watch production metrics for execute-phase publish failures after deployment
